svg.aria-label: Drawn scene of a made-up metro station after the work is finished: the crew has gone, the handover pack on a table has one empty slot for a missing test sign-off, retention money sits in crates behind a closed barrier, and the customer engineer waits at the gate to accept.
svg.text: Section through a finished metro station · a made-up example · not to scale
Work finished. The crew has gone
Handover pack: one test sign-off missing
